programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Jungle Hunt
programmes.d: Will seeks confirmation of his first experience on Mako Island. Bella volunteers to misdirect his search so he won't find the Moon Pool. The girls and Lewis discover the Moon Pool has changed.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Keep Your Enemies Close
programmes.d: Cleo seeks a new job as an assistant dolphin trainer at the Marine Park. Rikki fires Nate's band from playing at the cafe until she and Bella reach an understanding.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Valentine's Day
programmes.d: Cleo is forced to put Lewis' plans for romance on hold to restrain Kim's out-of-control love life. During this time, Don meets Samantha, a National Parks manager, and they start dating.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Big Ideas
programmes.d: Zane concocts a dirt bike race to publicize the café. When Rikki discovers it's a scam, she and Bella decide to teach him and Nate a lesson. Cleo and Lewis make a major discovery about mixing the waters in the Moon Pool.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Secrets and Lies
programmes.d: Bella attempts to start a relationship with Will until she sees he's apparently got another girl. Lewis tests the magic Moon Pool water at school and attracts the attention of their Science teacher.
Gus has an incredible string of good luck culminating in his becoming the captain of the school's Soomer-crosse team. When Cassy becomes jealous of her pal's success.
When Gus and Cassy accidentally sit in Siege Perilous, the legendary throne of Galahad created by Merlin, they begin to return to their magical “roots.”
The ghost of a salty old captain has been regaling Gus with tales of traveling the seas. Consequently, Gus hasn't been studying for his mid-terms.
Verne arrives at his new boarding School in Hamburg for his first day and is horrified to discover that it is filled with all manner of magical beasts and beings!
A rainy day traps the girls inside. In an effort to play sick, the girls create a situation where their families become part of a dire medical emergency.
The full moon has come again, and the girls are taking every precaution they can imagine this time. It proves to be in vain, however, when Rikki falls under the spell.

Cleo and Kim are fighting like crazy and Cleo is pushed to breaking point. Then cousin Angela comes to stay and things just get worse. Cleo realises there are more challenging things than an annoying sister.
Lewis enters the annual fishing derby. When Cleo sees him struggling, she decides to help him out with disastorous consequnces. Meanwhile, Rikki and Zane are trapped on a hotel balcony.

Zane thinks Miss Chatham holds the key to the sea monster. Emma needs a change so dyes her hair red. While Zane gets closer to the secret, he also gets closer to Rikki. Zane dives to Miss Chatham’s boat and sees a mermaid!

Emma and Cleo find out Zane and Rikki are an item and force her to choose – him or them. When Zane appears to side with Harrison over the Mako island development Rikki’s decision is clear. Now it’s Zane’s turn to make a choice…
Trouble ensues when Eerie's first automatic teller machine becomes obsessed with Simon.
In order to save his parents' marriage, Marshall must locate his dad's lost briefcase. During the search, Marhsall and Simon encounter yet another strange happening in Eerie.
Fourteen year old Erin has little else to do in her small town than to make up stories.
Gary is like any other 14-year old boy yearning for some privacy.
Randall loves to invent things, even if it means destroying other peoples belongings.
Vincent will stop at nothing to win.

Rip & Co. wing to Japan to investigate reports of a live Oni, the Japanese Demon. They discover that the Oni report is a cover-up for something even more fantastic: the discovery of the magical Daruma Dolls.
While diving around an old shipwreck, Rip and Samantha have their yacht stolen on the high seas by the modern pirates.
Rip, Cyril, and Sam travel to Cairo, Egypt to investigate the case of a woman put in a coma by the Curse of King Tut, after trying to buy contraband artifacts from the dead Pharaoh's tomb.
When a young woman collapses in the town square of the Transylvanian town of Poenari, it is discovered she has a vampire bite on her neck!
When an Alliance raid on a Banshee clan permits the escape of Banshee renegade, Sh'lainn Blaze, the Alliance turns to professional bounty hunter Nick Logan for help...
Rinaker wants Nick and Sh'lainn eliminated because he's afraid they know too much about the Alliance...
Battles heat up as the bladers earn points for entry into the Battle Bladers competition; Gingka meets a new rival, Tsubasa, who tests his strength.
Kyoya comes across a calculating opponent Tobio, aka Captain Capri, whose moves appear erratic but not unstoppable by Kyoya.
Tsubasa proves his worthiness as a blader and joins forces with Doji's Dark Nebula Organization.
The competition to make it into Battle Bladers heats up with Yu battling Hyoma and Tsubasa battling Kenta...

The ancient empire Atlantis is returning to Earth.
When Sonic and Tails are captured by Grounder and Scratch, Sonic tricks them into letting them escape by reminiscing about how they all met which also explained how Scratch and Grounder were created.
In an effort to catch both Veronica and Betty's attention, Reggie attempts to steal some of Dilton's physique enhancing solution.
Riverdale's citizens are scared into a state of shock, being found clutching overdue library book notices.
Archie and Jughead get locked in the Riverdale museum with a mummy inexplicably determined to get revenge against our boy hero.
When practical joker Reggie scares Archie with a Wolfman mask, his prank backfires!

'The Inspector's Most Wanted': A criminal from The Inspector's past seeks revenge by having him perform on the all-too-realistic Cop Patrol television show. 'Pinky Appleseed,' Pinky's efforts to re-plant a forest are obstructed by Paul Bunyan.

'Calling Dr. Panther': The Panther must save his Boss from the clutches of a mad doctor. 'For Those Who Pink Young': The Panther gets a child's view of the world when he is accidentally shrunk to kid-size by Professor Von Schmarty's fun machine.

'Lights, Camera, Voodoo': Security guard Panther comes up against an egotistical star, a demented director and an obsessive fan at a movie studio. 'I'm Dreaming of a Pink Christmas': Pinky tries to instill the spirit of Christmas in a 'scrooge.'

'Wiener Takes All': The Panther runs a successful hot dog business until the competition kidnaps the founding granny. 'The Easter Panther': When the Panther is hired to handle the White House Easter Egg Hunt, he must foil a heist by the Dogfather.
Scott tries to earn money to pay for an electric guitar. He helps at his dad's shop, but finds raising money is a lot more difficult than he expected.
Scott and his family mysteriously become unable to control their wolf-outs and worry that the town monster, that has been covered in recent news reports, is actually them.
Mr. Bean gets a real bug for painting. Then several bugs… and flies and slugs and mice. There’s easy money to be had in the art world and Mr. Bean is set on getting some of it.

Bean fights a losing battle with a winged beast from Hell. When Mr. Bean finds a fly in his room, it's war. He needs weapons. Fly spray? A rolled-up magazine? These are only the start. In desperation, he enlists a mouldy doughnut, an encyclopedia.

The Battle of the Mimes. A leisurely stroll in the park turns into a run when Mr. Bean is chased home by an angry Mime Artist. He is lost for more words than usual when the street performer makes himself at home and insists on being wined and dined.

Mr. Bean finds that cleanliness can be a filthy business. It's the First Day of Spring and Mr. Bean sets about washing his clothes, his furniture, his teddy and himself. But, alas, there’s no hot water!
Sabrina needs a little lesson in true love for her Shakespeare play. While Zelda just needs a date. They conjure up Romeo to teach them the ropes.
Sabrina is excited when her father drops in for a visit. She's disappointed to find that her father has brought along with him his fiancie.
It's Salem's birthday and he's used to getting the lavish gifts. Sabrina thinks her homemade gift sucks so she time travels to get him a unique gift...
Gem hosts two exchange students to be cool. Instead of the real foreigners, Dawson and Felicity, show up instead. Psst! They are really mischievous faeries.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Happy Families
programmes.d: A problematic family beach picnic leads Don to end his relationship with Samantha, until Cleo encourages him to pursue it. Will's sister, Sophie, competes with Bella for a job at the café and sets her sights on Zane.
